organisms: Species specific dung preferences were recorded for eight species, two of which prefer horse dung and six of which prefer cow dung
title and abstract.summary: The study investigated the differences in dung beetle communities attracted to horse or cow dung from a functional diversity standpoint, examining 18 functional traits across eight recorded species. The study measured the molar area and conjunctive area of dung beetles colonizing horse and cow dung, comparing traits between species attracted to each dung type.
